dedupe_keys.name: flood mapping of the river murray 250gl series on south australian government data directory

description: Flood Mapping of the River Murray 250GL (series on South Australian Government Data Directory) is a series of datasets listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Environment and Water. This study was undertaken to assist in flood preparedness and risk management activities for the River Murray. The study predicts the flood extent for a range of flows when measured at the border to South Australia which are expressed in megalitres per day (ML/d). Scenario datasets released include: lOOGL,120GL,130GL,140GL, 160GL, 180GL, 200GL, 250GL, 300GL, 341GL. Coverage: South Australia. The portal lists 10 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Environment and Water. Its tags are environment, flood, river murray. It offers 4 resource(s) in geojson, html, kmz, shp. The portal shows 2020-02-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
